newsitem.title: USA: Equitable's Equitable Life unit CEO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Equitable's Equitable Life unit CEO resigns.

text.p: Equitable Cos Inc said Friday that James Benson, president and chief executive officer of Equitable's principal insurance subsidiary, Equitable Life Assurance Society of the U.S., is resigning effective May 1.

the company said Joseph Melone, president and chief executive officer of Equitable Cos and chairman of Equitable Life, will assume Benson's responsibilities on an interim basis until a new CEO of the life company is named.
Benson said while at The Equitable he had successfully repositioned the company, seen its sales, earnings, and capital rise, and put in place a solid management team.
"I believe the time is right to move on to new opportunities," he said.
